_william.pearson_: Nobody asked Oskar Pearson why he came. Nobody in S-F10 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Oskar Pearson was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F10 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Oskar Pearson wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Oskar Pearson found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
Oskar Pearson fired at a movement across the wire at S-F10. The man went down: Norbert Fransinlak, grazed.

Oskar Pearson has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F10 with the rations. Oskar Pearson ate while listening to the revised orders.
Dawn watch. Oskar Pearson put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Isidor Acquillae, badly wounded.
The parcel for Oskar Pearson contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Oskar Pearson tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Oskar Pearson aimed a step ahead and fired: Bastian "Owl" Hanka, grazed.
The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F10 they left Oskar Pearson behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Emil Galvanooooo of the Hegemony (@galvanooooo).

Gideon Pearson had heard about Oskar Pearson's courage. At S-F10, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. Gideon Pearson answered the first call, number 38 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.

Gideon Pearson found an old map of the Chalk Pits from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Gideon Pearson kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Someone in S-F10 asked Gideon Pearson about Port Abel. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Gideon Pearson waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.
Gideon Pearson and Bram Yma share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
Gideon Pearson got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.

The Hegemony raiders came over at S-F10 in the middle of the night. Gideon Pearson met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Teodor Varsikasikra of the Hegemony (@varsikasikranaatti).
A letter came with Gustav Pearson: "I am Gideon Pearson's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Gustav Pearson watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing.
adamsapple128: On Day 10, Viktor Adamsapple arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Viktor Adamsapple added a leak above the man's head in pencil. A letter from home reached Viktor Adamsapple before dusk. Viktor Adamsapple read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Viktor Adamsapple could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Viktor Adamsapple had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Pavel "Owl" Hughesjack was grazed. A letter from home reached Viktor Adamsapple before dusk. Viktor Adamsapple read it twice and slept a little easier.
Viktor Adamsapple pulled Felix Solano out of a flooded shell hole at the Sunken Road. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Viktor Adamsapple spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.

At Q-F19 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Viktor Adamsapple won the bet. Jonas "Mole" Yeti was badly wounded. A single shot from across the wire hit Viktor Adamsapple in the thigh at Q-F19. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev of the Concord (@slevvinkilevra).
Nobody could reach Viktor Adamsapple in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
Valentin "Rabbit" Adamsapple took the same post at Q-F19 where Viktor Adamsapple stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Isidor "Brick" Crab wrote a letter for Valentin "Rabbit" Adamsapple's mother, because Rabbit could not find the words. Rabbit signed it.
bomb_6868: After 10 days of war, T-F1 had a place for everything. On Day 10, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Leopold Bomb.

Leopold Bomb was hit in the foot through his boot at T-F1. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Tobias Tyleraldridg of the Concord (@tyleraldridge45). Leopold Bomb was killed outright at T-F1, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Tobias Tyleraldridg of the Concord (@tyleraldridge45).

Another member of the House of Bomb reached the line: Roland "Hollow" Bomb. He asked where Leopold Bomb had slept, then chose a different corner. Victory at Grey Mill. Roland "Hollow" Bomb let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Roland "Hollow" Bomb was hit through the chest at T-F1. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Severin Guy of the Concord (@hi.its.guy). A single shot at T-F1. Roland "Hollow" Bomb sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Severin Guy of the Concord (@hi.its.guy).
The House of Bomb sent Isidor "Tin" Bomb after Roland "Hollow" Bomb. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Blast from a trench mortar threw Isidor "Tin" Bomb against the trench wall at T-F1. Ringing ears, a split lip, and no intention of leaving.

A bullet struck Isidor "Tin" Bomb below the ribs at T-F1. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Casimir Adammyers of the Concord (@adammyers575). Isidor "Tin" Bomb was hit at T-F1 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Casimir Adammyers of the Concord (@adammyers575).
The papers connected Felix Bomb to Isidor "Tin" Bomb. The men took longer to learn Felix Bomb's own habits, but they made the effort.

Felix Bomb was hit through the stomach at T-F1. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Casimir Adammyers of the Concord (@adammyers575). The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Felix Bomb. He was asleep before they set him down. The surgeon did everything that could be done, but the fever came anyway. Felix Bomb died in the night with an orderly holding his hand.
Walter Bomb joined T-F1 under the shadow of Felix Bomb's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Walter Bomb offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
Walter Bomb's hands still remember being a medical student's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
danwolves91: Florian Danwolves found a place in N-F11 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak. After the loss of Grey Mill, Florian Danwolves helped stack spare sandbags at N-F11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Florian Danwolves shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
Florian Danwolves and Yann "Button" Hen spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
Florian Danwolves crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at N-F11 holds again.

Florian Danwolves offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Danwolves. Florian Danwolves read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Florian Danwolves spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
Florian Danwolves of the Concord and Rafael Gundam of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near Sorrow Copse all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
flamboyantnoble: Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno came up on Day 9 carrying news from Coldwater. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

The water jacket hissed as Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Teodor Autismosupre was gravely wounded. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A parcel came for Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at Q-F11. Before dawn Walter "Ghost" Wllame walked into it, badly wounded.
Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.

Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Silas Shorlock was grazed trying to cross it. A bullet clipped Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno's helmet at Q-F11 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril of the Concord (@damiancarrillo2003).
Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno sat on an ammunition box at Q-F11 with a bandaged leg and gave advice to everyone who passed. Nobody asked for it.

A bullet found Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno at Q-F11, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard of the Concord (@firekeyboard). Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno lies on a stretcher in the communication trench. All day, men step past carrying food and ammunition the other way.
flumpus.wumpus: Day 8: Silas Wumpus reached R-S14 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Silas Wumpus went down at Saint-Ash crossroads and did not get up. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Silas Wumpus reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up. Silas Wumpus recognized the orderly today and said the orderly's name out loud. The surgeon says he will pull through.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-S14 with the rations. Silas Wumpus ate while listening to the revised orders.

Silas Wumpus returned to R-S14 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs. The clerk counted the names twice. Silas Wumpus is number 529 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Silas Wumpus read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Silas Wumpus across the shin at R-S14. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Clement Wanter of the Hegemony (@wanter_cz).
Silas Wumpus walked back up the communication trench to R-S14, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Silas Wumpus cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry.
Two men fed the belt while Silas Wumpus held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Ivo Hohne was grazed.

Silas Wumpus had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Jakub Marshall was badly wounded. Brass cases piled up around Silas Wumpus's boots at R-S14. Out of all those rounds, one found Casimir "Spark" Dominickg, badly wounded.
Silas Wumpus and Henrik Sleepyman carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
ikaikaism: Clement "Mole" Ikaikaism reported to V-F19 with a child's drawing of a horse sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Clement "Mole" Ikaikaism has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
The cook borrowed Clement "Mole" Ikaikaism's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.

Clement "Mole" Ikaikaism had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Bastian Mongus was badly wounded. A grenade fragment found Clement "Mole" Ikaikaism's shoulder. He calls it a souvenir and refuses to be sent back.
Clement "Mole" Ikaikaism rejoined the squad at V-F19. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Emil Ronnie stood up to sing louder, and Clement "Mole" Ikaikaism fired. Emil Ronnie was badly wounded. The singing stopped.
kennypulkinen: At the depot, Dorian "Parson" Kennypulkine had practised answering to his name. At R-R14, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Dorian "Parson" Kennypulkine helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Dorian "Parson" Kennypulkine and Edmund Ahmadhcj share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Dorian "Parson" Kennypulkine during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Dorian "Parson" Kennypulkine and Florian Joshbanaka tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
The corporal found out Dorian "Parson" Kennypulkine used to be a farmhand. Dorian "Parson" Kennypulkine has been doing two jobs ever since.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Dorian "Parson" Kennypulkine put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.

Dorian "Parson" Kennypulkine was found at the bottom of the trench at R-R14, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Silas Ofieczkaares of the Concord (@ofieczkaares). Dorian "Parson" Kennypulkine was killed outright at R-R14, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Silas Ofieczkaares of the Concord (@ofieczkaares).
A letter came with Yann Kennypulkine: "I am Dorian "Parson" Kennypulkine's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

Yann Kennypulkine had just lit a cigarette at R-R14 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Felix "Mole" Ngles of the Concord (@gsh1ngles).
Yann Kennypulkine came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
michal_velcic: "You're late," said the corporal when Clement "Ash" Velcic arrived on Day 11. "Everyone's late. Get a spade." The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into V-F14. Clement "Ash" Velcic has learned to walk bent double.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Clement "Ash" Velcic. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. Mail came up the line with a letter for Clement "Ash" Velcic. Clement "Ash" Velcic read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Someone asked Clement "Ash" Velcic to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. Mail came up the line with a letter for Clement "Ash" Velcic. Clement "Ash" Velcic read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Clement "Ash" Velcic found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.

A bullet went into Clement "Ash" Velcic's chest just under the heart at V-F14. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Isidor Smhorner of the Hegemony (@smhorner56). Clement "Ash" Velcic looked over the parapet at V-F14 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Isidor Smhorner of the Hegemony (@smhorner56).

Pavel Velcic asked about Clement "Ash" Velcic on arriving at V-F14. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. After what happened at Saint-Ash crossroads, Pavel Velcic asked to serve as a machine gunner. Nobody argued.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Pavel Velcic in the open at V-F14. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory of the Hegemony (@wesley.gregory.00). Pavel Velcic fired at the enemy dawn watch from V-F14. Isidor Smhorner was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Pavel Velcic was killed at V-F14 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Ulrich "Hollow" Gregory of the Hegemony (@wesley.gregory.00).
Rafael "Doc" Velcic joined V-F14 under the shadow of Pavel Velcic's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Rafael "Doc" Velcic and Edmund Theconcordal compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house. Mail came up the line with a letter for Rafael "Doc" Velcic. Rafael "Doc" Velcic read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
mixtapethepyromancer: The quartermaster asked Yann Mixtapethepy to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

The Hegemony sentry, Viktor Newnario, shouted once. Yann Mixtapethepy silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@newnario) Night raid. Yann Mixtapethepy crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Yann Mixtapethepy. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Yann Mixtapethepy watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Mixtapethepy. Yann Mixtapethepy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Yann Mixtapethepy took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for. Yann Mixtapethepy got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 855. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Yann Mixtapethepy kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Yann Mixtapethepy changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Yann Mixtapethepy and Henrik "Button" Fish spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Yann Mixtapethepy took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-R12, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag.
Yann Mixtapethepy lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
The medics would not give up on Yann Mixtapethepy. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to R-R12 today.
A round came through the loophole Yann Mixtapethepy was watching at R-R12 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Arno "Hollow" Trout of the Hegemony (@salty__trout).
nex_time42: Ivo Time unpacked a tin whistle at P-F19. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Ivo Time could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Ivo Time and Casimir Eclark made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. A letter from home reached Ivo Time before dusk. Ivo Time read it twice and slept a little easier.
Someone in P-F19 asked Ivo Time about Lindenbruck. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted. A letter from home reached Ivo Time before dusk. Ivo Time read it twice and slept a little easier.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Ivo Time. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Ivo Time washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Ivo Time waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.

Ivo Time was hit in the forearm at P-F19. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Dietrich Dalton of the Concord (@zeek.dalton).
ragman.irl2: On the way to T-F15, Konrad Irl tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Machine-gun fire swept T-F15. Konrad Irl took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex of the Concord (@xdissonvncex). Konrad Irl looked over the parapet at T-F15 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex of the Concord (@xdissonvncex).

The papers say Leopold Irl. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Konrad Irl's eyes. Nobody in T-F15 argues. Victory at Grey Mill. Leopold Irl let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A bullet hit Leopold Irl's belt buckle at T-F15 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch of the Concord (@paintbusch).
Leopold Irl no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit Leopold Irl in the neck at T-F15. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Clean sheets, a lamp, and a surgeon. Leopold Irl was admitted to the hospital dugout and finally let go of his rifle. Leopold Irl recognized the orderly today and said the orderly's name out loud. The surgeon says he will pull through.
Leopold Irl lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Leopold Irl died waiting. The men at T-F15 have not stopped talking about it.
Roland "Smokes" Irl had heard about Leopold Irl's courage. At T-F15, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Roland "Smokes" Irl offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
shallowcrow114: Day 9: Leopold Shallowcrow reached S-R1 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Leopold Shallowcrow wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

At S-R1 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Leopold Shallowcrow won the bet. Ivo "Mole" Dylansteele was grazed. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Leopold Shallowcrow during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Leopold Shallowcrow was hit in the forearm at S-R1. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Roland "Mole" Tuckerdesave of the Concord (@tuckerdesaveur).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Leopold Shallowcrow is whole again, or near enough for the line.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Leopold Shallowcrow. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Leopold Shallowcrow kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
Leopold Shallowcrow did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Leopold Shallowcrow fired back. Emil Nayam was grazed.
A loose thread in Leopold Shallowcrow's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
smooth._.tony: Cyril "Mud" Tony was a baker in Ashford Vale until the posters went up. He came to V-F13 with a lucky button, and within a day the whole squad knew that he polishes his buttons every evening. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Cyril "Mud" Tony watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Cyril "Mud" Tony brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Cyril "Mud" Tony's ear at V-F13 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Casimir Singh of the Hegemony (@aishwarya.singh_05).

Cyril "Mud" Tony was hit in the hip at V-F13. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Wendel Rebootreboot of the Hegemony (@rebootrebooted). The bearers reached Cyril "Mud" Tony at V-F13 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Wendel Rebootreboot of the Hegemony (@rebootrebooted).
Marek Tony came to the front because his uncle Cyril "Mud" Tony never came home. He carries a lucky button.
A round went through the rim of Marek Tony's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Ivo Skootybazoom of the Hegemony (@skootybazooms).
The medics cleaned Marek Tony's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at V-F13.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at V-F13 and grazed Marek Tony's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Wendel Rebootreboot of the Hegemony (@rebootrebooted).
superb.ryan: On the way to R-R9, Anselm Ryan tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Anselm Ryan has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Felix Crobus, badly wounded. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Anselm Ryan did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Anselm Ryan saved the last of the sugar for Rafael "Saint" Dawgdawghuuu's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Saint's birthday. It was a good day anyway. Anselm Ryan got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 995. The men who came later will ask about it. Victory at Grey Mill. Anselm Ryan let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Anselm Ryan (Hegemony) and Karel Pavla (Concord) came to the same broken well at Saint-Ash crossroads at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-R9. Anselm Ryan fired at the last man to run. Quentin Zicharyafour was grazed.
Anselm Ryan cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
A bullet clipped Anselm Ryan's helmet at R-R9 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe of the Concord (@tomtomaustheim).
Back on the fire step at R-R9. Anselm Ryan says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.

The sergeant at R-R9 called out a range and a spot. Anselm Ryan was the only one who hit it. Jakub Harrison was badly wounded. Anselm Ryan raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R9. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Gustav Egga of the Concord (@egga15627).
valiantlyvaliancy: Nobody saw Otto Valiantlyval arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-F6, and a quiet sniper under it.

Otto Valiantlyval pulled Lucien Raphoto out of a flooded shell hole at the Brickworks. Neither of them has mentioned it since. Both of them remember. Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Otto Valiantlyval could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Otto Valiantlyval noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed.

A clear shot from S-F6. Otto Valiantlyval badly wounded Yann Jimmysparrow and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home reached Otto Valiantlyval before dusk. Otto Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.

The dugout roof dripped into Otto Valiantlyval's mug. He moved the mug. The roof found another way. A letter from home reached Otto Valiantlyval before dusk. Otto Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Otto Valiantlyval kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Otto Valiantlyval spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. A letter from home reached Otto Valiantlyval before dusk. Otto Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.

Otto Valiantlyval had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Dietrich Wolfmananton crossed it, Otto Valiantlyval fired. Dietrich Wolfmananton was grazed. A letter from home reached Otto Valiantlyval before dusk. Otto Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.

Otto Valiantlyval moved to a new hide at S-F6 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Dietrich Wolfmananton, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Otto Valiantlyval before dusk. Otto Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.

Otto Valiantlyval mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted. A letter from home reached Otto Valiantlyval before dusk. Otto Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.

In the dark of the Hegemony trench Otto Valiantlyval hit Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@hackermt90) Night raid. Otto Valiantlyval crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Otto Valiantlyval. A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F6. Otto Valiantlyval was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Matthias Mihai of the Hegemony (@angel._.mihai).

Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval put a frozen apple beside the bunk. Someone who had known Otto Valiantlyval helped clear the shelf without saying why. Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a stretcher bearer. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval before dusk. Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval answered to number 158. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-F6. Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval has learned to walk bent double.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval's ear at S-F6 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Matthias "Doc" Gaita of the Hegemony (@gaita_4119). A letter from home reached Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval before dusk. Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval rejoined the squad at S-F6. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval before dusk. Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval was hit twice at S-F6, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval was carried in at last. Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval died in the ward while the orderly was reading him a letter from home. The orderly finished the letter anyway.
The House of Valiantlyval sent another. Marek Valiantlyval, father of Benedikt "Owl" Valiantlyval, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

Marek Valiantlyval and Leopold Mejci both swear they saw a ghost at Hill 304. Each says the other screamed first. A letter from home reached Marek Valiantlyval before dusk. Marek Valiantlyval read it twice and slept a little easier.

At S-F6 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Marek Valiantlyval turned around and took a shovel blow. Cyril Rttr of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Cyril Rttr of the Hegemony (@19rttr97). Marek Valiantlyval went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Dorian Caleb was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@ya_man_caleb) Marek Valiantlyval joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. The letter for Marek Valiantlyval asked if the food was good. Marek Valiantlyval wrote back that it was. That was a lie, but a kind one.

Machine-gun fire swept S-F6. Marek Valiantlyval took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Zeno Tonyhuang of the Hegemony (@tonyhuang000). Marek Valiantlyval got a letter with a recipe in it. Nobody in the trench had any of the things it needed.
wiwiwib3: Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib arrived with the Day 4 draft, carrying a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
A parcel from home held a comb. Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.

A clear shot from S-F19. Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib grazed Severin Guy and slid back down below the parapet. The guns found S-F19. Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib was dug out of a collapsed dugout with both legs pinned and carried back on a groundsheet. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
The beds were full. Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib waits on a stretcher in the dark with a medic's promise and a dry mouth.
The medics would not give up on Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F19 today.
Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib kept Arno Dick awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Whistle could have walked there blind.
Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.

Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib was on the dawn watch at S-F19 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Karel "Tin" Normale of the Concord (@marcello.normale). News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A bullet went through Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib's upper arm at S-F19 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick of the Concord (@grizzlychicken1). Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib was hit at S-F19 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick of the Concord (@grizzlychicken1).

The House of Wiwiwib sent another. Ivo "Crow" Wiwiwib, uncle of Oskar "Whistle" Wiwiwib, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. The clerk counted the names twice. Ivo "Crow" Wiwiwib is number 257 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Victory at Grey Mill. Ivo "Crow" Wiwiwib let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Ivo "Crow" Wiwiwib agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Ivo "Crow" Wiwiwib asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Ivo "Crow" Wiwiwib tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
The artist tried again while Ivo "Crow" Wiwiwib read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
Ivo "Crow" Wiwiwib sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare.
A reply from home thanked Ivo "Crow" Wiwiwib for the portrait. It is already on the mantelpiece, where the family apparently recognises the ears.
